product.title: Half Day in Middle Earth - Lord of the Rings Tour

description.text: In Queenstown, this small-group Middle-earth half-day leaves Shotover Street for Skippers Canyon, Arrowtown, and Lake Hayes with movie props for photographs. The published circuit stays in the Wakatipu Basin rather than the Glenorchy and Arcadia Station route used by the Paradise Valley outing. The format suits visitors who want a compact filming-location window without a 4WD river crossing. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Queenstown, and the itinerary stays on Skippers Canyon, Arrowtown, and Lake Hayes that define this outing rather than a Gibbston Valley wine cave afternoon.

highlights: Skippers Canyon and Arrowtown filming stops

end.description: Return to the Queenstown meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
